Frozen evidence from this run; extracted values below, original bytes attached inside Receivables Findings DRAFT.pdf.
N1 Kestrel Point Hotel Partners LLC

On June 18, 2026 our project manager agreed in writing to credit $28,600.00 for corridor finishes on floors 7 to 9 damaged by our drywall subcontractor. Credit memo CM-0627 was issued on July 8, 2026 and recorded in July. The June 30 aging shows the full final billing.

The district withheld $41,250.00 of the retainage release as liquidated damages: 15 days at $2,750.00 a day under section 8.3. We asked on July 20 for a 12-day time extension for the district’s late hazardous materials abatement; the district has not answered. We have recorded nothing for it.

The clinic disputes the final billing, $186,935.00, which includes the medical gas and nurse-call changes it says it never signed. We filed a lien on February 27, 2026. Corliss has made no payment since December and did not answer our letters of March, May and July. No allowance is recorded.
We record no allowance. We have collected every contract receivable in full in the last three years except where a credit was agreed.
For: the audit team, at its request
